tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Learn what you will build, the workshop scope, and the required prerequisites.

tutorials.title: Get Started
tutorials.description: Sign in to your Oracle Cloud account and prepare to use your tenancy.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Create the OCI Oracle Linux, Apache, PHP, and MySQL HeatWave GenAI Environment
tutorials.description: Create Oracle Linux, Apache, PHP, and a private MySQL HeatWave GenAI DB System.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Create the MySQL HeatWave Database for Inputs, Reviews, Results, and Audit History
tutorials.description: Create MySQL HeatWave tables for saved inputs, reviewed lines, results, rule versions, and workflow events.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Build the PHP Input and Saved Comparison Review Pages
tutorials.description: Build two freeform inputs and save comparisons in MySQL HeatWave.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Align Confirmed RHEL and Oracle Linux Lines and Build the Cost Results Page
tutorials.description: Align representative-confirmed lines and calculate traceable subscription-cost results.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Use MySQL HeatWave GenAI to Format Inputs and Build the Representative Review Page
tutorials.description: Use ML_GENERATE to convert both freeform inputs into validated suggestions for human review.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Test, Deploy, and Demonstrate the Complete Application Workflow
tutorials.description: Test the full workflow and rehearse the prototype demonstration.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Review common problems and find directions for receiving help.
